title: Rabbi Tachlifa of Caesarea
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Rosh Hashanah 4:8, Taanit, beginning of chapter 2, and Nedarim 1:2.
Rabbi Zeira raised a difficulty against him: Jerusalem Talmud Sotah, end of chapter 5.
In Shemot Rabbah, beginning of chapter 25, he spoke in the name of Rabbi Pila.
In Pesikta deRav Kahana 7a: Rabbi Yudin, Rabbi Levi, Rabbi Tachlifa of Caesarea and Resh Lakish — one said, etc.
In Bamidbar Rabbah 12:15: Rabbi Tachlifa of Caesarea and Rabbi Shimon ben Lakish, etc.

Seder HaDorot cites that he spoke in the name of Rabbi Shimon ben Levi, from the Yalkut on Shir HaShirim, remez 988; Hyman proposes the reading as in Shir HaShirim Rabbah, chapter 4, on the verse “Honeycomb”: Rabbi Huna and Rabbi Tachlifa of Caesarea in the name of Rabbi Shimon ben Lakish.

notes.text: The supplied כשם is read as בשם. The chapter/halakhah locators are Jerusalem Talmud. Pesikta deRav Kahana 7a is retained as the supplied historical-page reading, without identifying a modern section. The proposed Shimon-ben-Lakish correction remains Hyman’s.

The complete consulted Midrash Rabbah—TE Bamidbar Rabbah 12:15 names Tachlifa of Caesarea with Shimon ben Lakish. Hyman’s other named parallels, historical Pesikta 7a locator and correction of the reported Yalkut/Seder HaDorot chain remain separately attributed, without identity admission.
